offering_description.value: Produces fuel-grade ethanol from corn at a single plant in Lamberton, Minnesota, and sells it to fuel marketers and blenders. It also sells distillers grains and corn oil co-products to livestock feed buyers, using a dry-mill process.

primary_products.value: fuel ethanol; distillers grains; corn oil

customer_segment.value: B2B: fuel marketers and blenders, animal feed dealers and livestock feeders

revenue_model.value: product sales: ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil sold to fuel and feed buyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts purchased corn and natural gas into ethanol and co-products, sold to fuel marketers and feed buyers

geography_served.value: US national: ethanol shipped by rail and truck across the US, distillers grains sold mainly in Minnesota and nearby states

specialization.value: niche specialist: single product line: fuel ethanol with distillers grains and corn oil co-products

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: third-party marketers that market and sell the ethanol output; direct sales: distillers grains and corn oil sold directly to feed and industrial buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard compliance and Minnesota Pollution Control Agency air and environmental permits

notes: Marketing arrangements and product mix may have changed; description is based on general knowledge.
